description: This file implements retry logic for HTTP requests within the Kubernetes client-go library, including error handling, retry attempts, backoff, and response processing.

classes.name: withRetry
classes.description: Struct managing retry attempts, backoff, and error tracking for HTTP requests.

classes.name: wrapPreviousError
classes.description: Custom error type wrapping current and previous errors for context.

methods.name: IsErrorRetryable
methods.description: Determines if an error from the server is retryable based on provided function.

methods.name: IsNextRetry
methods.description: Decides whether to proceed with a retry based on attempt count, response, and error.

methods.name: Before
methods.description: Prepares the request for retry, including backoff and throttling.

methods.name: After
methods.description: Records the result of a request attempt, updates metrics, and backoff state.

methods.name: WrapPreviousError
methods.description: Wraps the previous error with current error for detailed context.

methods.name: trackPreviousError
methods.description: Tracks the most recent errors for retry context.
